newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Iddison Vietnam announces option rights.
newsitem.headline: Iddison Vietnam announces option rights.

text.p: Iddison Group Vietnam on Wednesday announced a renounceable rights issue of 11,817,196 October 2000 $0.35 options to option holders on September 5.
The issue will raise approx $215,665 and will be made on the following terms -
* 10/99 options - entitlement on a 1:1.5 basis and on payment of $0.01 per new option.
* non-participatory 10/97 options - entitlement to new options on a 1:1.15 basis and on payment of $0.02 per option
* participatory 10/97 options - entitlement to new options on a 1:1.5 basis and on payment of $0.092 per new option
* Non-participatory 09/97 option - entitlement to new options on a 1:3 basis and on payment of $0.02 per new option.
The option restructure resulting will be put to share and option holders to consider at the company's annual meeting.
